verses.1: So Israel set out with all that he had, and when he came to Beersheba, he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
verses.2:
And that night God spoke to Israel in a vision: “Jacob, Jacob!” He said.
 “Here I am,” replied Jacob.
verses.3: “I am God,” He said, “the God of your father. Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there.
verses.4: I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will surely bring you back. And Joseph’s own hands will close your eyes.”
verses.5: Then Jacob departed from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel took their father Jacob in the wagons Pharaoh had sent to carry him, along with their children and wives.
verses.6:
They also took the livestock and possessions they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and Jacob and all his offspring went to Egypt.
 Those Who Went to Egypt
 ( Exodus 1:1–7|EXO 1:1-7 )
verses.7:
Jacob took with him to Egypt his sons and grandsons, and his daughters and granddaughters — all his offspring.
 The Children of Leah
verses.8: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel (Jacob and his descendants) who went to Egypt: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
verses.9: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.10: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, + 46:10 Jemuel is another name for Nemuel ; see Numbers 26:12|NUM 26:12 . Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, + 46:10 Zohar is a variant of Zerah ; see Numbers 26:13|NUM 26:13 and 1 Chronicles 4:24. and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
verses.11: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.12:
The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
 The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
verses.13: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, + 46:13 Hebrew; SP and Syriac Puah ; see 1 Chronicles 7:1|1CH 7:1 . Job, + 46:13 Hebrew; SP and some LXX manuscripts Jashub ; see Numbers 26:24|NUM 26:24 and 1 Chronicles 7:1. and Shimron.
verses.14: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.15:
These are the sons of Leah born to Jacob in Paddan-aram, + 46:15 That is, northwest Mesopotamia in addition to his daughter Dinah. The total number of sons and daughters was thirty-three.
 The Children of Zilpah
verses.16: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, + 46:16 SP and LXX Zephon ; see also Numbers 26:15|NUM 26:15 . Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, + 46:16 Arodi is a variant of Arod ; see Numbers 26:17|NUM 26:17 . and Areli.
verses.17:
The children of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah.
 The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
verses.18:
These are the sons of Jacob born to Zilpah — whom Laban gave to his daughter Leah — sixteen in all.
 The Children of Rachel
verses.19: The sons of Jacob’s wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.20: Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph in the land of Egypt by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On. + 46:20 That is, Heliopolis, as in LXX
verses.21: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
verses.22:
These are the sons of Rachel born to Jacob — fourteen in all.
 The Children of Bilhah
verses.24: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.25: These are the sons of Jacob born to Bilhah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Rachel — seven in all.
verses.26: All those belonging to Jacob who came to Egypt— his direct descendants, besides the wives of Jacob’s sons— numbered sixty-six persons.
verses.27:
And with the two sons + 46:27 Hebrew; LXX the nine sons , probably including Joseph’s grandsons through Ephraim and Manasseh; see 1 Chronicles 7:14–29|1CH 7:14-29 . who had been born to Joseph in Egypt, the members of Jacob’s family who went to Egypt were seventy + 46:27 Hebrew (see also Exodus 1:5|EXO 1:5 ); LXX (see also Acts 7:14) seventy-five in all.
 Jacob Arrives in Egypt
verses.28: Now Jacob had sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to get directions to Goshen. When Jacob’s family arrived in the land of Goshen,
verses.29: Joseph prepared his chariot and went there to meet his father Israel. Joseph presented himself to him, embraced him, and wept profusely.
verses.30: Then Israel said to Joseph, “Finally I can die, now that I have seen your face and know that you are still alive!”
verses.31: Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s household, “I will go up and inform Pharaoh: ‘My brothers and my father’s household from the land of Canaan have come to me.
verses.32: The men are shepherds; they raise livestock, and they have brought their flocks and herds and all that they own.’
verses.33: When Pharaoh summons you and asks, ‘What is your occupation?’
verses.34: you are to say, ‘Your servants have raised livestock ever since our youth — both we and our fathers.’ Then you will be allowed to settle in the land of Goshen, since all shepherds are detestable to the Egyptians.”
